verdicts.reason: A has a clean shared left edge and a logical brand→headline→sub→pills→CTA order. Its flaws: the headline wraps with an orphaned 'here', the right half of the canvas is dead space, and the peach circle in the bottom-right floats with no connection to anything. B's headline is oversized and runs almost to the right edge. Its left edges don't line up (wordmark and subhead at about 76px, headline at about 64px), the CTA sits off to the right, wedged between the subhead and the pills, and the flavour pills are pushed to the bottom below the button, so the reading order and grouping fall apart.
